_comment: Where the game window lives, in Windows virtual-desktop pixels. Read by
integration/second-screen/build_pack.py to work out where to park the tactical
map and the Formation Manager window; rewritten from the real desktop by
A region is normally one physical monitor. Under NVIDIA Surround / AMD
Eyefinity the two monitors are ONE logical display to Windows, so the regions
are instead the left and right halves of it - the arithmetic is the same.
mode: 'second-screen' places the panels in the 'panels' region. 'single-screen'
makes the pack a no-op that ships vanilla geometry - set it (or re-run the
detector) before playing on one monitor, or the map is parked off-screen.
source: Stated by the user, 2026-09-20: two 2560x1440 monitors, side by side, panels on the right. Not yet confirmed against the live desktop - run tools/detect-displays.ps1.
